crossRefs.note: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and served the Baals.
They abandoned Yahweh, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.
The children of Israel said to Yahweh, “We have sinned! Do to us whatever seems good to you; only deliver us, please…
They put away the foreign gods from among them and served Yahweh; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
because that they have forsaken me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab…
Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for…
Ephraim, what have I to do any more with idols? I answer, and will take care of him. I am like a green cypress tree…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Then the children of Israel removed the Baals and the Ashtaroth, and served Yahweh only.
translations.bsb: So the Israelites put away the Baals and Ashtoreths and served only the LORD.
translations.kjv: Then the children of Israel did put away Baalim and Ashtaroth, and served the LORD only.
translations.asv: Then the children of Israel did put away the Baalim and the Ashtaroth, and served Jehovah only.
